## What this changes and why

## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request is one logical change.
- [ ] I opened an issue first, if this is more than a small fix, and linked it here.
- [ ] Tests cover every behaviour change.
- [ ] `bundle exec rspec` passes locally.
- [ ] `bundle exec rubocop` passes with no offences.
- [ ] No comments added beyond a class's top-level description.
- [ ] Commit messages are one imperative sentence, with a body explaining why.
- [ ] This does not rename a tool or change a JSON-RPC error code without a major version bump.
- [ ] Any new migration avoids acronym-prone tokens in its file name and adds no foreign key on
      `admin_id`.
